Name: Set up Stripe subscription tiers
Description: Owner: Alex and Taylor. Deadline: Within next two weeks. Task: Configure three subscription tiers (Basic at $29/month, Pro at $49/month, Enterprise at $99/month) in Stripe, reflecting the pricing and features described: Basic includes AI model selection tool and limited features; Pro adds additional features and priority support; Enterprise includes all features, custom support, and integration options. Ensure these tiers are correctly integrated into the app's functionality and user experience.

Name: Develop Stripe Elements-based checkout form
Description: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: Within next two weeks. Task: Create a customizable, secure checkout form using Stripe Elements that matches the app's clean, straightforward design. The form must include a clear comparison of subscription features, a prominent checkout button, and a tooltip or help icon explaining plan changes. Handle errors such as invalid card details and insufficient funds gracefully.

Name: Update pricing page with subscription tiers
Description: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: Within next two weeks. Task: Revise the pricing page to display the new subscription tiers (Basic, Pro, Enterprise) and their corresponding features and pricing clearly to users.

Name: Implement user dashboard subscription management
Description: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: Within next two weeks. Task: Develop user dashboard features to display current plan details and billing info, enable upgrading, downgrading, or canceling subscriptions, provide access to invoices and payment history, allow payment method updates, and reflect real-time subscription status with notifications of changes such as plan upgrades or payment failures.

Name: Integrate Stripe API for subscription management
Description: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: Within next two weeks. Task: Integrate Stripe's API on the backend to create and manage subscriptions, process payments (successful and failed), and manage webhook events. Ensure backend correctly handles subscription creation upon payment completion.

Name: Set up webhook handlers for Stripe events
Description: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: Within next two weeks. Task: Implement webhook handlers for the following Stripe events: invoice.payment_succeeded (confirm payments and activate subscriptions), invoice.payment_failed (notify users and prompt payment method update, send email notifications), and customer.subscription.deleted (manage subscription cancellations, update access rights, and offer re-subscription). Ensure these handlers update the system correctly.

Name: Create test scenarios and test plan for Stripe integration
Description: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: One week after initial integration. Task: Develop a detailed test plan including manual and automated tests covering the entire subscription flow from sign-up to billing and management. Create test scenarios simulating events like payment failures and subscription cancellations to ensure webhook handlers and backend integrations function as expected.

Name: Integrate frontend with backend subscription API
Description: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: One week after initial backend setup. Task: Connect frontend components with the backend API to ensure real-time reflection of subscription changes on the dashboard. Handle user notifications for subscription confirmations, payment errors, and other relevant events with clear messaging and instructions.

Name: Prepare user documentation and support materials
Description: Owners: Alex, Jordan, Taylor. Deadline: After completion of integration and testing. Task: Develop clear user instructions and help resources, including a help section or FAQ covering managing subscriptions, accessing invoices, and resolving common issues. Taylor to document API endpoints and webhook handlers for maintenance and troubleshooting.

Name: Schedule and conduct follow-up meeting
Description: Owner: Alex. Deadline: Next week. Task: Organize a follow-up meeting to review progress, discuss any issues or blockers encountered, and align next steps for the Stripe subscription integration project.
